newsitem.title: UK: Abbey confident of attractive ScotAm bid.
newsitem.headline: Abbey confident of attractive ScotAm bid.

text.p: Abbey National is confident that its revised bid for mutually-owned life assurer Scottish Amicable will be attractive to the ScotAm board and policyholders, Abbey chief executive Peter Birch said on Thursday.
"We are very confident that our proposition will be attractive to the ScotAm board and its policyholders," Birch told Reuters in an interview.
The Abbey earlier confirmed that it would be making a formal bid for ScotAm on Friday but Birch declined to comment on any of the details of the revised bid.
The Abbey sparked a bidding war for ScotAm in January when it made a preliminary offer of up to 1.4 billion stg and was followed by a larger bid by insurance giant Prudential Corp.
ScotAm, which had been planning to shed its mutual status and eventually float on the stock exchange, then started a formal bidding process and offers have to be in on Friday.
